prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling school science fair. On the left stands a girl in a yellow raincoat, her posture stiff with anticipation as she grips a clipboard tightly. Next to her, positioned slightly behind, is a boy wearing oversized glasses who leans forward eagerly, pointing at a bubbling beaker on the table. In the center rests a large volcano model made of clay, its crater stained with dried red vinegar residue. To the right of the volcano sits a tabby cat, perched calmly on a folding chair, watching the chaos with detached amusement. Beside the cat, a teacher in a tweed jacket observes the students, holding a steaming mug of coffee in one hand while gesturing toward the experiment with the other. Near the front edge of the table, a small robot with blinking blue lights moves slowly across the surface, navigating around scattered index cards. The girl in the yellow raincoat looks directly at the boy with oversized glasses, sharing a moment of triumph as their project succeeds. The teacher in the tweed jacket interacts with the tabby cat by gently scratching behind its ears while maintaining focus on the students. There is no digital screen or electronic display visible in the background, ensuring the focus remains on tangible, hands-on learning tools and physical models. The soft washes of color highlight the yellow of the raincoat, the brown of the cat, and the red stains on the volcano, while the pencil lines define the intricate details of the robot and the expressions of the participants.
